mentions.note: died June 24th aged 61; six AAA Championship walking wins; AAA 2 and 7 miles champion 1939 and 1948, 7 miles 1947 and 1949; 5th in 1948 Olympic 10000 metres track walk; won Horwood Cup 1931; 3rd in RWA Junior 10 miles 1933 leading Club team to victory; held World record for 5 miles walking; won inaugural R.W.A. 10 miles Championship at Sheffield 1947 and again in Hyde Park 1948
